		has_country_flag = dtp_open
	}
	from = {
		check_variable = {
			which = dtp_pidx
			value = 14
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		exists = event_target:dtp_tc_14
	}
	from = {
		OR = {
			check_variable = {
				which = dtp_tab
				value = 2
			}
			check_variable = {
				which = dtp_tab
				value = 16
			}
			check_variable = {
				which = dtp_tab
				value = 7
			}
		}
	}
}
